findings.obs_text: In Psa 19:14 and Psa 104:34 the meditation runs from the person to God as something offered: it is to be acceptable in his sight, pleasing to him.
findings.grounds: May my meditation be pleasing to him

findings.obs_text: In Psa 1:2, Psa 77:3 and Job 15:4 the meditation runs from the person toward what is God's: his law, God remembered, meditation before God.
In Pro 5:21 the pondering runs from God to man: the Lord weighs the paths of a man.

In Gen 24:63, Psa 119:23 and Act 10:19 the meditating or pondering is the person's own and turned inward: Isaac in the field with no object named, the servant on the statutes, and in Act 10:19 a word comes to the one pondering while he ponders.
findings.grounds: while Peter was pondering the vision

findings.obs_text: In 1Ki 18:27 the word runs from Elijah to the prophets, in mockery: the musing he names is a state he ascribes to their god.
